name: Hostinger
summary: Affordable, fast hosting with an AI website builder built in. Free domain, free SSL and 24/7 support — perfect for founders launching their first MVP or side project.
best_for: budget-conscious owners and side projects that want cheap, decent hosting and will prepay a multi-year term
skip_if: you run a business-critical, high-traffic site — the renewal jump and shared-tier limits make managed hosting the better long-run value
honest_knock: The headline price only holds if you prepay years up front — renewals run several times the intro rate, the number-one complaint. Budget for the renewal, and be realistic that budget shared hosting isn't managed-grade performance.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month (48-month prepaid term, $143.52 upfront), renews at $10.99/mo
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-18, read on their own web-hosting and VPS pages) Shared and WordPress hosting runs four tiers on a 48-month term. Premium is $2.99/mo ($143.52 up front, 3 sites, 20 GB SSD) renewing at $10.99. Business is $3.99 ($191.52, 50 sites, 50 GB SSD) renewing at $16.99. Unlimited is $4.99 ($239.52, unlimited sites, 50 GB NVMe) renewing at $17.99. Cloud Startup is $7.99 ($383.52, 100 GB NVMe) renewing at $25.99. VPS is a separate ladder on a 24-month term — KVM 1 at $6.49/mo (1 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 50 GB NVMe, 4 TB bandwidth) renewing at $11.99, then KVM 2 $8.99 renewing $14.99, KVM 4 $12.99 renewing $28.99 and KVM 8 $25.99 renewing $49.99. Every plan is paid upfront for the whole term, the monthly figure being the total divided by the months, and every plan carries a 30-day money-back guarantee. Both the shared plans and the VPS plans include a free domain for one year.
